headline: Claude Maps the Bug-Hunting Workflow
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns authorized penetration testing into a disciplined sequence of reconnaissance, validation, evidence collection, and reporting. Its 83 skills and 681 vulnerability patterns give security researchers a structured playbook while keeping scope and operational boundaries visible.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Method
lede: Superpowers replaces impulsive code generation with a staged engineering process: discover requirements, validate a design, plan the work, then implement against tests. Worktrees, subagents, and review checkpoints make autonomous development resemble a governed production system.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Software an Agent Interface
lede: CLI-Anything wraps complex desktop and web applications in predictable command-line harnesses that agents can discover and operate. From Blender to Zotero, its registry turns scattered application workflows into installable, testable terminal capabilities.

headline: MiniMind Builds a Language Model in Reach
lede: MiniMind makes the full language-model stack small enough to study on a consumer GPU. Its PyTorch-first repository walks from tokenization and pretraining through LoRA, preference optimization, serving, and tool use without hiding the machinery behind abstractions.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents to Real Work
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog packages agent skills, coding workflows, and business-system integrations as discoverable units. Teams can extend one agent environment from code review and SDK work to records, documents, recruiting, and customer operations.

headline: Firecrawl Turns the Live Web Into Context
lede: Firecrawl handles the difficult path from dynamic pages and documents to clean, structured material for AI systems. Crawling, rendering, search, monitoring, and interactive browser actions move through one pipeline, ready for retrieval systems and research agents.

headline: NGINX Keeps Traffic Moving at the Edge
lede: NGINX remains a compact workhorse for serving content, terminating TLS, proxying APIs, balancing load, and caching responses. Its master-worker architecture and text-based configuration expose the performance-critical controls without obscuring the deployment model.

headline: OpenVINO Brings Inference Down to Hardware
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training ecosystems into optimized representations for CPUs, GPUs, and Intel NPUs. Its tooling spans quantization, serving, and generative inference, making deployment efficiency a measurable engineering concern rather than an afterthought.

headline: Diagram Design Makes Architecture Click
lede: Diagram Design turns a plain-language brief into a polished standalone HTML and SVG composition. Its 44 diagram types, grid-aware layout checks, and brand extraction give agent-generated visuals a stronger sense of structure, spacing, and identity.

headline: Last30days Builds an Evidence Trail for Now
lede: Last30days gathers recent signals from forums, video, markets, news, repositories, and research into one attributable brief. Parallel searches and source-level evidence help researchers separate durable patterns from the noise of a fast-moving month.
